typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	flightplanmigrationsnowchangedataimporttbl_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{App ID} as string,
		{Application Name} as string,
		CIO as string,
		{NGDC Comp Type} as string,
		{Component Migrate By} as string,
		{App Migration Date} as string,
		CR as string,
		{START DATE} as string,
		STATUS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ChangeData
ChangeData derive(importdate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		App_ID as string,
		STATUS as string,
		Application_Name as string,
		Component_Migrate_By as string,
		importdate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CIO as string,
		NGDC_Comp_Type as string,
		START_DATE as string,
		App_Migration_Date as string,
		CR as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		App_ID = {App ID},
		STATUS,
		Application_Name = {Application Name},
		Component_Migrate_By = {Component Migrate By},
		importdate,
		CIO,
		NGDC_Comp_Type = {NGDC Comp Type},
		START_DATE = {START DATE},
		App_Migration_Date = {App Migration Date},
		CR),
	partitionFileNames:[($flightplanmigrationsnowchangedataimporttbl_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> flightplanmigrationsnowchangedataimporttbl
